rounds: I could tell Coca-Cola from a supermarket cola in a blind test.
Big logos on clothes look cheap.
I would queue for an hour on a new shop’s opening day.
I would pay more for exactly the same product with a famous name on it.
Luxury brands are worth the money.
A famous face in an advert sells more than a better product.
Most brand collabs are just a gimmick to sell more stuff.
Most people choose a brand to fit in, not to stand out.
